headline: Lam Research, Xerox, FormFactor, Microsoft And Other Big Stocks Moving Higher On Thursday
summary: Dow Jones index gained 300 points, Lam Research Corp rose 20.1% after reporting strong financial results. Xerox, Columbus McKinnon, and other stocks recorded gains.

headline: AI Spending Boom Just Made US Economy Look Weaker Than It Really Is
summary: US GDP grew 1.5% in the second quarter, below forecasts. Imported servers and chips for AI data centers subtracted from the headline number.

headline: Stock Market Today: Microsoft Ignites Chip Rebound as SanDisk Jumps 24%
summary: Microsoft's 43% cloud growth revived the AI trade and lifted chipmakers, but Meta's guidance miss and a 19-year high in 30-year yields capped the rebound.
